maps.name: Doe Valley, KY
mapInfo: Scenic lakeside living at its finest. Come enjoy plentiful fishing in a rural setting.
The downtime offers the finest in shopping experiences including a bookstore,
hardware store, rural supply store, and a general store.
Escape the sprawl and consider one of the cozy little neighborhoods just off main street
while enjoying the locally famous nearby canteena. We'll see you in Doe Valley.
